verses.en: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead:
verses.sm: Iesepela Ua valaau e le perofeta o Elisaia le tasi soo o le au perofeta, ua faapea atu i ai, Ina fusi ia lou sulugatiti, ma ave i lou lima lenei fagu uu, ma e alu i RamotaKiliata;

verses.en: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;
verses.sm: a E oo foi i ai ia e sailia Ieu le atalii o Iosefatu le atalii ia o Nimesi, i le e ulu atu, ma fai atu ia te ia ia tulai ai luma o ona uso, i le ave ia te ia i se afeafe tuloto;

verses.en: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.
verses.sm: ona e tago ai lea i le fagu uu, ma liligi ifo ai i lona ulu, ma fai atu, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Ua ou faauu ia te oe e fai ma tupu o Isaraelu. I le è toina le puipui, ma e sola, aua lava neʻi e faatali.

verses.en: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o le taulealea, o le perofeta foi le taulealea, i Ramota-Kiliata.

verses.en: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu ia, faauta, o nonofo mai alii e pule i “au; ona fai atu ai lea o ia, Le alii e, O laʻu feau ia te oe. Ona fai mai ai lea o Ten, O se fea ea o i matou nei uma? Ona fai atu ai lea o ia, Le alii e, o oe lava.

verses.en: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel.
verses.sm: Ona tulai ai lea o ia, ua ulu atu i fale; ona liligi ifo lea e ia o le uu i lona ulu, ua fai atu ai ia te la, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu, Ua ou faauu ia te oe e fai ma tupu o le nuu o le ALI, o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.
verses.sm: E te fasia le aiga o Aapo lou alii, ina ia ou taui ma sui ia Iesepela le toto o a'u auauna le au perofeta, atoa ma le toto o auauna uma a le ALII.

verses.en: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:
verses.sm: Ana o le a fano le aiga uma lava o Aapo; ou te faaumatia foi i sa Aapo o se tulai atu i se aupa, o le pologa atoa ma le saoloto ua i Isaraelu;

verses.en: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:
verses.sm: ou te faatatau foi le aiga O Aapo i le aiga o Ierepoamo le atalii o Nepata, ma le alga O Paasa le atalii o Akia;

verses.en: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. And he opened the door, and fled.
verses.sm: Io e “aina foi e uh Iesepela i le fanua o Isereelu, e leai foi se na te tanumia o ia. Ona toina lea e ia o le puipui, ua sola.

verses.en: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.
verses.sm: Ona toe alu atu ai lea o Ieu i auauna a lona alii. Ona fai mai lea o le tasi ia te ia, Pe ni malie pe ni tamai? O le a le mea na sau ai lea vale ia te oe? Ona fai atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, Ua outou iloa le tagata atoa ma lana feau.

verses.en: And they said, It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel.
verses.sm: Ona P. TUPU 9 latou tali mai ai lea, Ua pepelo. Ina taʻu mai ia ia te i matou. Ona fai atu ai lea o ia, Ua faapea ma faapea lana upu ia te au, ua fai mai, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Ua ou faauu ia te oe e fai ma tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.
verses.sm: Ona faataalise ai lea o i latou, ua taitasi ma tago i lona ofu, ma tuu i lalo ia te ia i luga lava o le ala faaapefai, ua faasasau pu, ma faapea atu, Ua fai Ieu ma tupu.

verses.en: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramoth-gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.
verses.sm: Ona foua ai lea o Ioramo e Ieu le atalii o Iosefatu, le atalii ia o Nimesi. (Na leoleo foi e Ioramo Ramota-Kiliata, o i latou ma Isaraelu uma, ona O Asaeli le tupu o Suria.

verses.en: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.
verses.sm: A ua foi atu le tupu o Ioramo i Isereelu e fofo ai ona manua na manua ai o ia ia Suria i le taua ma Asaeli le tupu o Suria.) Ona fai atu lea o Ten, Afai e tatau ia te outou, aua neʻi sola se tasi i le aai nei e alu e taʻu atu i Isereelu.

verses.en: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.
verses.sm: Ona tietie ai lea o Ieu i le kariota, ua alu Isereelu, aua na taoto ai loramo; ua alu ifo foi Aasaia le tupu o Iuta e oʻooʻo ia Ioramo.

verses.en: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?
verses.sm: Ua tu foi le tagata vaai i luga o le ‘olo i Isereelu; ona iloa atu ai lea e ia o le vao tagata o Ieu o loo alu atu; ona fai atu ai lea, Ua ou iloa atu le vao tagata. Ona fai mai lea o loramo, Ina au atu ia O se tietie i se solofanua na te faafetaiaiina i latou, ma fai ane i ai, Pe filemu ea?

verses.en: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o le tietie i le solofanua e faafetaiai ia te ia, ua faapea atu, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le tupu, Pe filemu ea? Ona fai mai ai lea o Ieu, Ona a seʻi filemu lava lea? Ina sau ia oe i oʻu tua. Ona fai atu ai lea o le tagata vaai, ua faapea atu, Ua co atu ia te i latou le na auina, a ua le toe foi mai.

verses.en: Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.
verses.sm: Ona auina atu ai lea e ia o le tietie i le solofanua o le atu lua lea; ua oo atu o ia ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le tupu, Pe filemu ea? Ona tali mai ai lea o Ieu, Ona a seʻi filemu lava lea? Ina sau ia oe i oʻu tua.

verses.en: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o le tagata vaai, ua faapea atu, Ua oo lava ia ia te i latou, a ua le toe foi mai; o le faamomo'e foi, e faapei o le faamomo'e a leu le atalii o Nimesi, aua e soona tele'a'i ona faamomo'e e ia.

verses.en: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.
verses.sm: Ona fai ane lea o Ioramo, Ina sauni ia. Ona sauni ai lea o lona kariota. Ona o ai lea o Ioramo le tupu o Isaraelu, atoa ma Aasaia le tupu o Iuta, taitasi ma lona kariota, ua la o e faafetaiai ia Ieu; ua latou fetaiai foi ma ia i le fanua o Napota le Isereelu.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?
verses.sm: Ua iloa Ieu e Ioramo, ona fai atu ai lea o ia, Ieu e, e filemu ea? Ona fai mai ai lea o ia, Se a se filemu, ona le ua tele ea o faitaaga a lou tina o Iesepela, ma ana togafiti faataulaitu?

verses.en: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.
verses.sm: Ona liliu ai lea o Ioramo, ma sola, ua faapea atu ia Aasaia, Aasaia e, o le fouvale le mea nei.

verses.en: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
verses.sm: Ona loʻu gase lea e Ieu o le aufana, ua fana ua lavea ai Ioramo i le vaitau‘au, ua ati le u i lona fatu; ona pau ai lea o ia i totonu o lona kariota.

verses.en: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Ieu ia Pitika o lana ave ‘au, Ina avae ia o ia, ina lafo i le fasi fanua o Napota le Isereelu, aua ia e manatua sa ta o toalua o tietie i le kariota, ma mulimuli atu i lona tama o Aapo, ona tuuina atu ai lea e le ALII o lena avega ia te ia;

verses.en: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.sm: o loo fetalai mai le ALII, Na ou iloa lava ananafi le toto o Napota ma le toto o ona atalii; o loo fetalai mai le ALII, Ou te taui atu foi ia te oe i lenei fanua. O lenei, ina ave ia e lafo ia te ia i le fanua, e tusa ma le afioga a le ALII.

verses.en: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e Aasaia le tupu o Iuta, ona sola ai lea o ia i le ala i le fale ua i le fanua. Ona tuliloa lea o Ieu ia te ia, ua fai atu foi, ia fasi foi ia te ia i le kariota. Ona fasia lea o ia i le aega i Kuru o i Ipelamo. Ona sola ai lea o ia i Mekito, ua oti ai.

verses.en: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea o ia e ana auauna i le kariota i Ierusalema, ua tanu ia te ia i lona tuugamau faatasi ma ona tama i le aai o Tavita.

verses.en: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.
verses.sm: O le tausaga e sefulu ma le tasi o Ioramo le atalii o Aapo na fai ai Aasaia ma tupu e pule ia Iuta.

verses.en: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.
verses.sm: Ua oo leu i Isereelu, ona logona lea e Iesepela, ona vali ai lea e ia ona mata, ma teuteu lona ulu, ua vaai mai i le faamalama.

verses.en: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?
verses.sm: Ua ulu atu leu i le faitotoa, ona fai mai ai lea o ia, Pe na manuia ea Semeri, o le na fasioti i lona alii?

verses.en: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.
verses.sm: Ona tepa ae ai lea o ia i le faamalama, ua faapea atu, O ai ea e ‘au ia te au? Po o ai? Ona vaai mai ai lea ia te ia o auauna sili e toalua pe toatolu.

verses.en: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia, Ia outou lafo ifo ia ia te ia. Ona latou lafo ifo ai lea ia te ia; ua pisia foi le pa ma solofanua i lona toto; ona soli ai lea o ia ia te ia.

verses.en: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king's daughter.
verses.sm: Ua ulufale atu o ia, ua “ai foi ma inu, ona fai atu ai lea, Ina asiasi ia i lena fafine malaia, ma tanu ia te ia; aua o ia o le afafine o le tupu.

verses.en: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.
verses.sm: Ona latou o ai lea e tanu ia te la; ua na o lona ulupoo, ma ona tapuvae, ma ona tapulima na latou maua.

verses.en: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:
verses.sm: Ona latou foi mai ai lea, ua taʻu mai ia te ia. Ona fai atu ai lea o ia, O le afioga a le ALII lea, na fetalai mai ai i lana auauna o Elia le Tisepi, e faapea mai, E “aina e uli le tino o Iesepela i le fanua o Isereelu;

verses.en: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.
verses.sm: e i ai foi le tino o Iesepela i luga o le laueleele i le fanua o Isereelu pei o otaota; latou te le faapea ane foi, O Iesepela lenei. O le fasiga o le aiga o
